title: 入境检查（二）：商务与追问
goal: 应对移民官的追问：职业、公司、见谁、带多少钱、以前来过吗；商务出行会说明来开会、参展。
tips: 免签或商务签入境时，不要说 I'm here to work（意思像是来当地打工），要说 I'm here on business / to attend a meeting / to visit a client。
What brings you here? = 你来这里做什么？和 What's the purpose of your visit? 意思一样。
邀请函、展会门票、酒店订单放在一起，被追问时一次性拿出来。

exchanges.hear: Which company do you work for?
Do you have an invitation letter?
exchanges.reply: Yes, from our client. Here it is.

exchanges.hear: Are you here for a conference?
exchanges.reply: Yes, I'm attending a trade fair.

exchanges.hear: How much cash are you carrying?
Do you have any relatives here?

exchanges.reply: Yes, I came here last year on business.

exchanges.hear: Can you show me your hotel booking?
exchanges.hearZh: 能给我看一下你的酒店预订吗？

lines.en: Good afternoon. What brings you here?
lines.zh: 下午好。你来这里做什么？

lines.en: I'm attending a trade fair in Frankfurt.
lines.zh: 我来参加法兰克福的一个展会。

lines.en: I'm a sales manager at an electronics company.
lines.zh: 我是一家电子公司的销售经理。

lines.en: Five days. I'm leaving on Saturday.
Do you have an invitation letter?
Yes. Here it is, and here's my hotel booking.
lines.zh: 有，在这里，这是我的酒店预订。

lines.en: All right. Have a good trip.
